content:
In light of e.g. this message by a new Zulip user:

I would, however, strongly recommend that whoever is responsible for configuring the system disable or clarify the email option mentioned in this message.

is there a way to do so?

Context:

  • the user is intelligent and not an AI agent
  • many other mailing lists, newsgroups etc. strongly prefer replying in plain text rather than HTML, so the user did so --- leading to rather bad formatting. I would say the user expectation was not unreasonable.
  • the general expectation here is for users to respond via the webpage --- making this clear by customising the notification would help!

Are we talking about Reply to this email directly, view it in Lean Zulip, or manage email preferences.?
If so, it's defined here:
https://github.com/zulip/zulip/blob/406a311c979fa8abb71f01b3b0c8b2136a774e75/templates/zerver/emails/missed_message.txt#L41
https://github.com/zulip/zulip/blob/406a311c979fa8abb71f01b3b0c8b2136a774e75/templates/zerver/emails/missed_message.html#L46

There doesn't seem to be a way to change or amend the message, but it seems you can disable the ability to respond through email by disabling the setting EMAIL_GATEWAY_PATTERN (idk if that's desirable)
We're talking about "Reply to this email directly".
Thanks for investigating! I'll forward this to the mods/admins of this instance.
